summary: postinstall downloads and executes a binary from a bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's npm postinstall script fetches a tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS URL (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz), extracts it, hardlinks the contained executable into the launcher's bin directory with mode 0755, and that binary becomes the code run when the user invokes the CLI. The fetch uses https.get with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling TLS certificate validation, and there is no hash or signature check on the downloaded bytes. The source is a bare IPv4 address rather than a publisher-owned domain, so the installer's `npm install` executes whatever code that endpoint (or any on-path attacker) serves. The binary is not shipped in the tarball and cannot be pinned or verified.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
